set -eu

cat > "$tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_JOURNAL_EOF'
[Journal]
Storage=persistent
Compress=yes
SystemMaxUse=512M
SystemKeepFree=1G
SystemMaxFileSize=64M
MaxRetentionSec=14day
MaxFileSec=1day

chmod 0644 "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/retention.conf
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
systemctl restart systemd-journald
journalctl --rotate
journalctl --vacuum-time=14days --vacuum-size=512M
